title: Betty and Barney Hill told the Air Force and the psychologist different versions

tellings.quote: Betty and Barney Hill for example telling the Air Force one story and then telling the psychologist another story.

plain: Chris Ramsay, a researcher and online host, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that Betty and Barney Hill, a New Hampshire couple who said they had an encounter with a UFO in 1961, told the US Air Force one version of their story and a psychologist another. He raises it as an example of how such accounts can shift depending on who is listening.
